question: Given sparse and noisy cumulative delivered output from a completed independent reset pulse trial, which candidate queue mechanisms remain plausible? Explain what the observations do and do not distinguish, and propose the most discriminating feasible next experiment without claiming to know the generating truth.

observability.instrument: Synthetic delivered cumulative output (units) from one completed pulse trial; reported construction times are relative [-8,0], and calibration_times are time since that trial's reset; no held-out values are provided. A proposed new experiment must reset the stocks again.

plausible rival parameter/structure analysis without inventing feedback or generator truth

preregistered_comparison.summary_rule: Keep both if adequate; any pruning requires reasoned physical contradiction. Do not reward pruning itself. Compare narrative merits explicitly; no objective causal discovery inference from two cases.
exclude: model truth or parameters in user prompt
